stories.title: Hezbollah attack on Israel drags fragile Lebanon back into war
stories.summary: Tensions in Lebanon are soaring as Hezbollah renews its attacks on Israel.

stories.title: U.S. gasoline prices set to jump with Iran war
stories.summary: The U.S. war with Iran is rattling energy and financial markets. Gasoline prices jumped overnight while stock prices tumbled.

stories.title: Israel marks somber Purim under Iranian missile fire
stories.summary: Israeli Jews are celebrating Purim and drawing parallels with the war in Iran and the ancient biblical story.

stories.title: Pregnant migrant girls are being sent to a Texas shelter flagged as medically risky
stories.summary: Government officials and advocates for the children worry the goal is to concentrate them in Texas, where abortion is banned.

stories.title: Roger Bennett's world revolves around the World Cup – and it always has
stories.summary: NPR's Juana Summers talks to Roger Bennet about his new book, We Are the World (Cup), and what could be in store in this year's tournament as America hosts for the first time in 32 years.

stories.title: An Arkansas manufacturer pins hope on apprenticeships
stories.summary: Virco Manufacturing has made school furniture since 1950. Now with competition from imports and an aging workforce, Virco is hoping to build the workforce it needs to survive through apprenticeships.
